extraction_warnings: Paper reports only aggregate/group-level statistics (n=41 controls, 56 pHTN, 99 HTN); no individual subject_id or sample_id values are provided in the text, so these required fields are 'not_reported'.
Detailed clinical characteristics (age, sex ratio, BMI values) are stated to be in Additional file 1: Table S1, which is not included in the provided text, so exact values could not be extracted.
The 'control' field's allowed values (Study Control/Case/Not Used) do not map cleanly to the three-group design (Control/pHTN/HTN); surface-form group labels were extracted instead per instructions.

A subset of 124 participants (30 controls, 31 pHTN, 63 HTN) and a separate validation cohort (3 HTN, 3 controls from Qin et al. data) are also described but not treated as separate subgroups here since the primary cohort (41/56/99) is the main study population.
Batch 1 subgroups ['Healthy control', 'Pre-hypertension (pHTN)', 'Hypertension (HTN)'] differ from batch 0 ['Control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.
Paper is a human gut microbiome/hypertension cohort study with mouse FMT experiments; most oncology-, neonatal-, and obgyn-related schema fields are not applicable and were marked not_reported.
fmt_role and smoker fields required inference/derivation from exclusion criteria and donor descriptions rather than direct statement.

Detailed clinical biomarker values (SBP, DBP, FBG, TC, TG, LDL) are referenced as being in Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not included in the provided text, so exact values could not be extracted.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['Control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.
study_name and pmid could not be extracted because author names and PMID are not present in the provided text (only DOI given).

sequencing_platform: main human metagenomic sequencing is described only as 'Illumina platform' without specific model; the specific 'Illumina HiSeq' model is stated only for the 16S rRNA mouse sequencing, creating some ambiguity for a single study-level value.

host_species: the study includes both human participants (main cohort) and mice (fecal microbiota transplantation recipients); the enum field only allows a single value, so 'Human' was chosen as primary with mouse experiments noted separately.
